rev6.release_notes: Updates: if CAD CAM is still open when G-SEND.IO closes, you are asked to close it, and CAD CAM's update installs. Before, it waited without a word.

cadcam.release_notes: Recognize Part runs on a new, faster engine, and measures non-turned faces exactly (a .4998 now reads .5000). New 2D Adaptive clearing toolpath (constant load), with its rest machining. Turning Setup: the part starts as Body1, Stock is fixed size from the part (next 1/4" or 10 mm bar, a bar size goes up one, +.2" / +4 mm long), the front end is picked by clicking a face. Turning op panel: Spindle M3 / M4 only, no Tool change or Insert turned over rows, the undercut follows the model or what you pick. Quick Setup shows the machine profile; right-click to save it as the default. Post Processors window is plainer: Export a post (right-click) or Export All, Import to bring posts in. Sketch Fillet / Chamfer: click a corner, type the size, Enter; the size carries to the next corners. CAD ribbon reordered: Sketch, Extrude, Revolve, Box, Cylinder, Hole, Thread, Press Pull, Fillet, Chamfer. Fillet / Chamfer: drag a box to pick edges. Drawings: plain views no longer freeze the window; each title block text can be moved, aligned and sized; the 3D sheet page prints the drawing alone on white. Train AI: Data sets with notes and if / then / except rules, arrows with notes on the picture. Fixes: Part Off rule, Simulate's tool lengths, outline text, saving never depends on the post.
